scientific_integrity: The all-genus estimates follow from fixed-dimensional Kunz hyperplane bounds and matching relative-box constructions; direct finite checks only corroborate the exact child-count correspondence.
scientific_limitations: Multiplicity is fixed; asymptotic constants and uniformity in growing multiplicity are not determined. The all-multiplicity one-child concentration differs from previously known density one of maximal embedding dimension. Historical priority is provisional because full 2019 Kunz-paper text remained inaccessible.
title: A sharp one-child law for fixed-multiplicity numerical-semigroup trees
